snippet.title: Eversiege: Untold Ages - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
The gates of Bastion are open ⚔️ Eversiege: Untold Ages is NOW AVAILABLE!

Retreating ends here. Defend Bastion against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to reverse the siege. Shape your playstyle in this hero-strategy rogue-lite solo or co-op up to 3 players.

Eversiege: Untold Ages is an indie game, developed by Tindalos Interactive and published by Dear Villagers.

Follow us:
• X: https://x.com/PlayEverSiege
• Discord: https://discord.gg/eversiege
• Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/EverSiege/

#steam #release
